summary:
The corrected successor executed cleanly (CheckRun 2322bd7884b749f89c3101f04bc82e78, completed, exit_code 0, parsing_errors empty, prerequisites matched) and this envelope records its measured conclusion. Comparisons are now unambiguous: comparison 0 (control, stale_suffix=false) → holds on event 1; comparison 1 and 2 (case, stale_suffix=true) → violated with valid_witness_indices [3], witness_complete and comparison_complete true.

The sourced defect: after installing a snapshot at index S, a follower whose persisted log still ends above S does not converge. installSnapshot (raft.go:1814-1953) restricts log removal to at or below req.LastLogIndex and never calls setLastLog, so getLastEntry (state.go:167-174) keeps returning the stale above-snapshot index/term; appendEntries (raft.go:1475-1502) rejects the leader's PrevLogEntry check with NoRetryBackoff; replicateTo (replication.go:222-260) walks nextIndex down to the compacted first index, hits ErrLogNotFound, and sendLatestSnapshot (replication.go:299-383) re-sends the same snapshot. Observed: follower applied index frozen at 45 while leader commit was 55 (stalled=true, isolated_caught_up=false); the control (log below the snapshot index) reached 55 (holds).

The envelope also marks the investigation `explained` with explicit boundaries: only liveness/progress is established (no committed-entry loss or safety claim), coverage is single-process in-memory InmemTransport/non-monotonic InmemStore/FileSnapshotStore, and restart/recovery of a node left holding an above-snapshot suffix was not tested. Scope, prefix, requirement, anchors and the prior opinion/counterevidence are preserved; no source or requirement was weakened. Validation reports valid=true. Draft file: `draft/snapshot_stale_suffix_verdict.json` (harness: `draft/snapshot_suffix_harness.go`).
